COURTS OF JUDICATURE ACT 1964

RULES OF THE FEDERAL COURT (AMENDMENT) 2013

IN exercise of the powers confer red by section 17 of th e Courts of Judicature Act 1964
[Act 91 ] and with the consent of the Chief Justice, the Rules Committee makes the
following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Rules of the Federal Court
(Amendment) 2013.

   (2)  These Rules come into operation on 1 March 2013.

Amendment of rule 46
2. The Rules of the Federal Court 1995 [P.U. (A) 376/1995], which are referred to as
the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended in subrule 46(1) by substitut ing for
the word "RM500" the word "RM1000".

Amendment of rule 56
3. Subrule 56(1) of t he principal Rules  is amended by substituting for the word
"RM500" the word "RM1000".

Amendment of rule 107
4. Subrule 107(4) of t he principal Rules  is amended by subst ituting for the word
"RM500" the word "RM1000".

Substitution of Second Schedule
5. The principal Rules are amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the
following schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

Court Fees

(rule 86)

  RM
1. Notice of appeal and Cross- Appeal 1000.00
2. Any interlocutory application 80.00
3. Memorandum of Appeal 80.00
4. On application to prepare an index 40.00
5. (a) Order on any interlocutory application 80.00
 (b) Final order on appeal 120.00
6. Petition  160.00
7. Notice of Petition 100.00
8. Notice of Motion  160.00
9. Summons For Direction 40.00
10. Amended Petition or Notice of Motion 20.00
11. Search Fee 12.00
12. Affidavit 16.00"

Made  27 February 2013
[JK/MP 322 Jld. 11; PN(PU2)153/XV]
